about_the_game:
Play as the Growmancer, a wizard traveling worlds with his canine companion to transform wastelands into fertile grounds and battle destructive wildfires. Upgrade both via a skill tree. Challenge yourself or just relax.

Play as the Growmancer, a mysterious sorcerer dedicated to greening barren worlds.

Progress through an expansive skill tree to unlock potent abilities.

Summon steadfast allies to assist in nurturing these new worlds.

...And defend vibrant ecosystems from destructive wildfires!

What Awaits You:

  • The Growmancer: Embody a wizard journeying through devastated worlds, transforming them into blooming gardens and controlling destructive wildfires.

  • Loyal Canine Companion: Your faithful dog assistant on your travels.

  • Incremental Upgrades: Collect flowers and invest them in a skill tree, unlocking improvements for both the Growmancer and your dog.

  • Core Mechanics: Land transformation, fighting wildfires, resource gathering, and ability upgrades.

  • Adjustable Difficulty: Choose between a relaxing experience or a challenge demanding intense focus.

  • Elements of Random Generation: Ensuring variety across multiple playthroughs.

  • Playtime: Approximately 2 hours for a single playthrough, but countless hours for those looking to replay, achieve 100% of achievements, or aim for higher scores.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit (latest Service Pack)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3 or AMD Phenom™ X3 8650
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 600 series, AMD Radeon™ HD 7000 series
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
